dct_description_sm: The data set includes Canadian reported custody decisions from 2015, as well as reported decisions in British Columbia and Ontario for 2005 and 2010. The cases are put within a data sheet with 18 different factors with the aim being to determine how Canadian custody/access/parenting cases are decided as a whole, and how they are decided in each jurisdiction.
